faq.subtitle: Har du spørgsmål? Vi har svar. Hvis du ikke kan finde det, du leder efter, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores supportteam.

1.question: Hvordan fungerer MTJRii?
1.answer: MTJRii giver dig mulighed for at oprette og administrere flere online butikker fra én kraftfuld platform. Opret blot din butik, tilpas den med dine produkter og branding, og begynd at sælge!

2.question: Er mine data sikre?
2.answer: Ja, vi bruger virksomhedsgrad sikkerhedsforanstaltninger til at beskytte dine data. Al information er krypteret og opbevaret sikkert. Du har fuld kontrol over dine privatindstillinger.

3.question: Kan jeg tilpasse min online butik?
3.answer: Absolut! Du kan tilpasse farver, skrifttyper, layout, tilføje dit logo, produktbilleder og meget mere. Vores platform tilbyder omfattende tilpasningsmuligheder.

4.question: Har jeg brug for tekniske færdigheder for at bruge MTJRii?
4.answer: Slet ikke! MTJRii er designet til at være brugervenligt. Du kan oprette og administrere dine online butikker på få minutter uden teknisk viden.

5.question: Kan jeg spore min butiks præstation?
5.answer: Ja, vores analytics-funktion giver dig mulighed for at spore salg, visninger, klik og engagement-målinger, så du kan forstå, hvordan dine kunder interagerer med dine butikker.

landing.cinematic.meta.title: MTJRii | Motion-first multi-store commerce
landing.cinematic.meta.description: A cinematic multi-store commerce landing powered by the project's existing Remotion system, brand palette, and localized content architecture.
landing.cinematic.header.subline: Brand, motion, and operations in one storefront system
landing.cinematic.hero.eyebrow: A living product presentation driven by the existing MTJRii motion identity
landing.cinematic.hero.title: Show the platform as motion, not as a stack of static blocks
landing.cinematic.hero.subtitle: The landing now opens as a cinematic commerce surface: strong product narrative, stronger text hierarchy, and a visual system anchored to the real blue-and-gold Remotion palette already inside the project.
landing.cinematic.hero.frameTitle: The first impression is driven by the live Remotion presentation layer
landing.cinematic.proof.items.one: Multi-store control, publishing, and public presentation stay inside one workspace.
landing.cinematic.proof.items.two: The page hierarchy stays readable even while motion, glow, and layered media stay active.
landing.cinematic.proof.items.three: Every visible landing string now resolves through the project's translation system.
landing.cinematic.story.title: The redesign follows what the product already is
landing.cinematic.story.subtitle: The codebase is a multi-store commerce platform with storefront themes, payments, content, analytics, and a real Remotion storytelling system. The landing now reflects that actual scope instead of acting like a generic SaaS shell.
The hero and section rhythm now focus on operators managing stores, themes, checkout, content, and reporting from one system.
landing.cinematic.story.items.motion.tit: Motion is a product layer, not decoration
landing.cinematic.story.items.motion.bod: The existing Remotion compositions now act as the living visual engine of the landing instead of being hidden as an isolated demo asset.
landing.cinematic.story.items.localizati: Localization is part of the architecture
The new landing copy is wired into the current i18n setup so all supported locales resolve through translation files instead of inline text.
landing.cinematic.motion.title: The page breathes through the same visual language as the video system
landing.cinematic.motion.subtitle: Large motion surfaces, layered gradients, and controlled glass panels now move together so the page feels cinematic without sacrificing legibility.
landing.cinematic.motion.playerTitle: Existing project compositions now drive the public product narrative
landing.cinematic.media.title: Real product surfaces are framed as a coherent visual sequence
landing.cinematic.media.subtitle: Dashboard control, theme setup, catalog work, order handling, and payment readiness are now presented as one connected brand story.
A real multi-store dashboard anchors the narrative instead of a generic hero illustration.
landing.cinematic.media.cards.themes.tit: Theme onboarding is treated as a strategic brand decision from the first scroll.
landing.cinematic.media.cards.orders.tit: Order workflows stay visible as part of the premium story, not buried as secondary admin detail.
landing.cinematic.media.cards.payments.t: Checkout readiness is presented as built-in platform depth, aligned to the actual gateway coverage in the repo.
landing.cinematic.media.cards.products.t: Product and content management appear as active commerce surfaces inside the same motion system.
landing.cinematic.templates.title: Storefront directions are shown as premium visual choices
landing.cinematic.templates.subtitle: The theme library is now integrated into the landing atmosphere, with stronger framing, stronger contrast, and a cleaner relationship to the brand palette.
landing.cinematic.footer.proof.two: Blue-and-gold brand palette aligned to the real video scenes
landing.cinematic.footer.proof.three: Localized landing content across the supported language set
landing.cinematic.footer.ctaTitle: Bring the real MTJRii motion system to the front of the product
landing.cinematic.footer.ctaSubtitle: Start with the guided setup flow, move into storefront direction, and continue inside the same operating system the landing now presents.
landing.cinematic.footer.description: MTJRii is presented as a premium multi-store commerce platform with live motion, strong readability, and a unified product story tied directly to the real codebase.
landing.cinematic.footer.sceneBody: The landing closes in the same visual language it opens with: cinematic motion, deliberate backgrounds, strong contrast, and a clear path into setup.
